scope: N4 types candidate/main Oracle release paired CPU comparison; not router or saturation qualification

statistics.primary: cgroup usage_usec delta / successful completions inside the measurement epoch
statistics.estimate: Per primary scenario: geometric mean of six paired fix/main CPU ratios and paired log-t 95% interval, df=5. Three AB and three BA pairs. Prior estimator unchanged.
decision: Lower 95% bound >1 confirms increased CPU for the tested workload, even below 10%.
Lower bound >1.10 confirms an increase exceeding 10%; 10% is a scale marker, not an allowed tolerance.
Interval crossing 1 is unresolved, not proof of zero regression or noise. Retain all paired and order-group values.
Upper bound below 1.10 bounds this tested workload below that scale, not equivalence.
Intervals are per scenario, not a familywise confidence claim.
statistics.guards: Two opposite-order pairs each for UDP/1000 records and TCP/0 records. Descriptive only, no inferential CI or S1 closure.
statistics.invalid_data: No retry, deletion, replacement, W/range filtering or all-pairs-direction rule. Keep every window/error. Invalid or incomplete scenarios cannot close the cost question.
